shorts.title: One King Cobra Ate 26 Venomous Pit Vipers in 4.5 Months
shorts.outro: Doug's six deaths are in the full video.
shorts.description: A radio-tracked wild king cobra in southern India kept eating pit vipers even after they bit back; Doug's whole trip through the king cobra's menu is in the full episode.

shorts.hook: A king cobra once swallowed a python three quarters its own length.
shorts.title: A King Cobra and a Python Were Found Dead Together
shorts.outro: Doug's other five deaths are in the full video below.
shorts.description: In 2018 a king cobra bit a reticulated python that was still coiled around it, and neither snake survived; the full episode follows Doug through everything else a king cobra eats.

shorts.title: King Cobras Eat Other King Cobras, Sometimes Alive
shorts.outro: Doug's six deaths are in the full video below.
shorts.description: In Singapore a king cobra was filmed swallowing another one alive, and two more fought for five hours; the full episode shows where Doug's ticket number comes up.
